records.entity: Banque de France printing works, Chamalières
records.detail: A collector reference site that catalogues notes printed in France says Djibouti's central bank is not part of the French banking system apart from the Banque de France printing its notes, and marks the printer field 'BdF' on the Djibouti entries it lists, running from the 500 and 1,000 franc notes of about 1979 through the 2,000 franc note of about 1999 and the 1,000 franc note of about 2005 to the 10,000 franc note of about 2009.
records.source_title: French Banknotes - French prints, Djibouti (Banque Nationale de Djibouti / Banque Centrale de Djibouti)
records.quote: other than Banque de France printing their banknotes

records.detail: A trade-press report on the launch of Madagascar's new ariary series on 17 July 2017 says the 20,000 ariary note, then worth about 6.80 US dollars, is printed on the Louisenthal hybrid substrate made by the German firm Giesecke and Devrient's paper mill. The report says the series uses several different substrates, and it does not say which company printed the notes.
records.source_title: Madagascar launches high-denomination banknote (Central Banking, 17 July 2017)
records.quote: is being printed on Giesecke and Devrient's (G&D) Louisenthal hybrid

records.detail: Banco de Guatemala's good-delivery gold bars, worth 2,027.7 million quetzales (263.1 million US dollars) at 31 December 2024, are deposited for safekeeping at the Federal Reserve Bank of New York; that is 263.1 million of the bank's 578.6 million dollars of monetary gold.

records.quote: el oro de buena entrega depositado en custodia en el Federal Reserve Bank of New York por Q2,027.7 millones (US$263.1 millones)

records.relation: holds its gold reserves in custody
records.detail: Banco de Guatemala keeps its coined gold, worth 2,431.2 million quetzales (315.5 million US dollars) at 31 December 2024, in its own reserve vaults; the remaining 263.1 million dollars of its monetary gold sits abroad, so most of the holding by value is in the bank's own building.

records.quote: oro amonedado que se encuentra en las Bóvedas de Reserva del Banco de Guatemala por Q2,431.2 millones (US$315.5 millones)

records.detail: The Bank of Mongolia states in its audited accounts that its monetary gold and silver are mainly placed at the Bank of England and at JP Morgan Chase Bank; the gold bullion so held was valued at 1,594,121 million togrogs at 31 December 2021.
records.source_title: Bank of Mongolia, Annual Report 2021, Audited Financial Statement, Notes to the Financial Statements, Note 13 Gold Bullion and Precious Metals
records.quote: Monetary gold and silver are mainly placed at the Bank of England and JP Morgan Chase Bank.

records.source_title: Bank of Mongolia, Annual Report 2021, Audited Financial Statement, Notes to the Financial Statements, Note 13 Gold Bullion and Precious Metals

records.detail: Of the Banque Centrale de Tunisie's 4,135,982 grams of gold bars at 31 December 2023, 2,729,950 grams sit in the bank's own vaults and 1,406,032 grams are placed on term; total gold holdings were 6.8 tonnes of fine gold, so about two thirds of the bar holding is physically with the bank.

records.relation: holds its gold reserves in custody
records.detail: Reporting Bangladesh Bank's audited 2025-26 accounts, Prothom Alo says the largest single share of the country's gold, about 188,927 troy ounces of a total 459,163.52 troy ounces (about 14.28 tonnes), is stored at the Bank of England, with 83,961 troy ounces in Bangladesh Bank's own vaults.
records.source_title: Prothom Alo English, "Most of Bangladesh's 14,000kg gold reserves stored in UK"
records.quote: A large portion of this gold is stored at the Bank of England.
